meta.name: m1d5-v1.2.3-single-case-diagnostic-application
meta.previous_application: M1-D-4 v1.2.2 single-case (approved; stopped at Q23; not reused)

run_config.execution_vehicle: production Service replay: rag_judge_service.judge_trace(session=None, trace=synthetic RagTrace, item=synthetic item, prompt_version='v1.2.3'); driver only aggregates JudgeOutcome; no reimplementation of F scoring

synthetic_trace.note: context_source=agent_chat is required by _skip_reason for F; no RAG adapter call; no RagEvaluationRun

fixture.note: fixed v1.1.5 gate answer/contexts/gold; no mutation of fixture; fixture target field is historical, v1.0.2 target is authoritative

run_config.llm_endpoint: existing DashScope-compatible endpoint used by prior qwen-max gates; no key in repo
run_config.credential_scope: existing runtime LLM credential (BYOK or server-key fallback); preflight must verify; no key in repo
run_config.env_scope: process-local for this Judge-only replay only; do not write to repo/.env; restore after replay

acceptance.strict_exception: skipped(no_decidable_claims) only if F coverage=0.0 and all factual claims insufficient_evidence
acceptance.mixed_sentence_warning: cl5 warning is acceptable but must be recorded in agent_contract.mixed_sentence_warnings

acceptance.semantic_rule: claim about 质量问题不受 7 天限制 must be insufficient_evidence unless a quote directly states that exemption
forbidden_support: 运费由责任方承担 quote supporting 7-day exemption
7 天内可换货 quote supporting 7-day exemption
acceptance.target_miss_policy: semantic_pass_target_miss -> stop and await human target review; do not change target
acceptance.f_one_policy: if F remains 1.0 and freight/exchange quote still supports 7-day exemption -> diagnostic fail; no in-round rerun

acceptance.quote_rule: single contiguous verbatim span; no cross-fragment concatenation

budget.count_rule: count every Judge model call, including repair and retry; stop when > 14 calls or > CNY 0.30
budget.no_repeat_policy: no repeat runs; single-case results are diagnostic only and are not counted toward the 10-case sample

stop_conditions.condition: Q23 quote 错误在 1 次 repair 后仍存在
Q23 absence 仍为 factual 或 supported，或 absence 附 evidence
Q21 F=1.0，或仍用运费/换货 quote 支持 7 天豁免
Q11 quote 拼接/契约违约，或 F/C/R 任一目标跌出区间
Q23 或 Q11 的 C/R 目标 miss
超过 14 Judge calls 或 CNY 0.30
任一 case 缺完整 F/C/R，或 invalid 路径缺 agent_contract

report_requirements: 逐 case/metric 报告 status、score、repair 轮、token/cost
报告 Q23 absence 四字段、cl5 mixed warning、quote 校验结果
报告 Q21 claim 级明细与 evidence quote 原文
报告 Q11 quote 连续性与三项目标
报告 C/R 去案例化后的重新核目标结果
写 model/temperature/max_tokens 与 judge_trace production Service replay 方法
标记 diagnostic only，不计入 10 条样本
结论只能写 implemented/verified/blocked；不得写 accepted
boundaries: 只跑 Q23/Q21/Q11，各 1 次、每次 3 指标；不是 10 条，也不是 40 条
不复用 v1.2.2 或更早批准；本申请已由 2026-11-23 决策批准
不创建 RagEvaluationRun、不写 DB、不调 WeKnora、不调 RAG adapter
不激活 v1.2.3；active/runtime_active 保持 false；默认仍 v1.0.0
不修改 Prompt、MANIFEST、Agent、Service、共享 validator、repair example、Schema、Metric、r2、target、fixture
看到结果后不得改目标，包括 Q21 目标 [0.6, 0.7]
不得跑 10/40；单案例通过后才可重新提交 10 条申请
单案例结果只作诊断，不得计入 10 条样本；10 条必须重新跑
不得把 M1-C/M1-D 标 accepted；M1-D-4 保持 blocked；M1-D-1/M1-D-3 保持 blocked
